Unlocked it. F5 Legacy, TLT, Medico, Writhe and Dark Vis vs. Skinwalker Gloomweaver at Temple of Zhu Long. I unlocked Cosmic Inventor Writhe sort of by accident.

Stuntman and the Void Guard against regular Baron Blade on the Mobile Defense Platform. Order of heroes was Stuntman, VG Dr. Medico, VG Idealist, VG Mainstay, VG Writhe.
https://pastebin.com/EfENNuiE


Shadow Cloak was put into play three times by Sink into Shadow and destroyed twice, once by Distorted Perception and once by Grasping Shadow-Cloth. Shadow Cloak was never played directly from Writhe's hand. It came into play once from Writhe's Deck and twice from Writhe's Trash.

The Shadow Cloak reduced damage taken by Writhe three times, twice reducing the damage taken to zero. Writhe never reduced damage taken by anyone else.

Writhe increased the damage he inflicted by 1 point on seven different instances - 5 times increased by the Shadow Cloak, 2 times increased by Lurking Shadows.

Portable Dark Lab was put into play once and destroyed itself after using it's power.

Umbral Siphon was put into play once by Portable Dark Lab, never destroyed and used twice. The first time it was used the Shadow Cloak increased the damage to 2 Melee and 2 Infernal, the second time it was used the combination of Shadow Cloak and Lurking Shadows increased the damage to 3 Melee and 3 Infernal.

Grasping Shadow-Cloth put into play once and the power on it used (with destroyed Shadow Cloak) to prevent Baron Blade's card draw.

Cloak Projector was put in play and the power on it used once, but Baron Blade didn't do any damage that turn to be reduced.

Writhe took damage once, reducing him from 19HP to 17HP. He ended the game at 19HP.

As for other people's equipment, VG Idealist played her Tiara early, VG Mainstay played his Durasteel-Studded Vest, and Stuntman played both his Stylish Armor and his Pistolet-Mitrailleur. VG Mainstay and VG Stuntman had equipment card types they never put into play.

So, I played one or more instances of every one of Writhe's pieces of equipment and used the power on each of his pieces of equipment that had a power at least once, as well as Writhe's own power at least once. Using a power more than once was also done, so it can't be a "use each power once and only once" thing. Could that have something to do with the unlock?

If you unlock a variant by meeting its conditions you won’t get notice of achieving it again.   So anyone who has unlocked Void Guard variants at this point won’t get notice of the unlock again.  There are ways to reset that people have found but not something I’m going to get into as it’s not really a supported item.  If the option to just unlock a variant was there and you used that then when you actually meet the conditions later on you’ll get the notice/achievement.
